column1: # The only cases allowed to differ from tests/golden/fx-golden.tsv (docs/FX-ENGINES.md section 5.4.3).
# tubamp_golden --verify <golden> --expected <this file>. Editing it needs the owner's sign-off.
# Columns (tab-separated): case pattern (wildcards, first match wins), audio rule, latency rule.
#   audio:   same | any | differs | same_as:<case> | off:<id>[,<id>...]
#            same_as: that case's captured hash at the same fs and block
#            off:     this build's render of the same case with those parameters at 0
# A case no line matches must be identical in audio and latency.
# amp_eq_on and eq_on default on at 5/5/5, so these chains carry a flat amp EQ (and classic
# a flat EQ block): exact pass-throughs now, so each must equal itself with them off.
